For the following companies: شركة الجبس الأهلية, شركة التعدين العربية السعودية,
شركة الصناعات الزجاجية الوطنية, شركة إتحاد مصانع الأسلاك

Calculate for FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025 (or latest 3 available fiscal years):
- DSO (Days Sales Outstanding)
- ROE (Return on Equity)
- CapEx to Depreciation ratio
- Debt to CapEx ratio

For each metric, cite the source financial statement and line item used.

Then provide a qualitative comparison of cash quality across these companies:
- Are earnings backed by real operating cash flow (compare net income to CFO)?
- Any red flags in working capital trends (e.g., rising DSO, inventory buildup)?
- Which companies look best-positioned for future cash generation, and why?

For all companies in the materials sector, break down Cost of Revenue into its
components (e.g., raw materials, direct labor, energy/fuel costs, depreciation
of production equipment — whatever line items exist in their statements) for the
most recent fiscal year available.

Present as a comparison table, and cite the source statement/note for each figure.
Flag any company where the cost of revenue breakdown isn't disclosed at that level
of detail.

Compare all materials sector companies on: Market Cap, Revenue, Net Profit, and
Cash Flow from Operating Activities, for the most recent fiscal year.

Present as a single sortable/rankable table. Note any company missing one of these
metrics rather than omitting it silently.

For Al Taiseer Group Talco Industrial Co. , Almasane Alkobra Mining Co. , Saudi Aramco Base Oil Co.  Saudi Paper Manufacturing Co. and Watani Iron Steel Co.  provide a comprehensive overview covering:
- Operational metrics (e.g., revenue growth, margins, efficiency ratios)
- Market metrics (e.g., P/E, market cap, EV/EBITDA if data available)
- Financial health metrics (e.g., liquidity, leverage, profitability ratios)

Reason through which metrics are most relevant given this
company's sector, and cite sources for all figures used.
